plugins.name: EasyCLIProxyAPI OpenCode Plugin
plugins.description: OpenCode Go provider (babico fork of xspeed1989/opencode-go-cliproxyapi): Responses tool-call lifecycle fix, tool-call id normalization (reasoning-free replays no longer fail with 400), chain-of-thought round-trip (client replay limited to the DeepSeek family), two-way credential reconciliation, dual zen/go plans, and a native OpenCode Go quota page. Renamed from opencode-go-provider in v2.3.0 (and opencode-go-cliproxyapi in v1.0.0); the provider name (opencode-go) and model prefixes are unchanged.
plugins.author: babico
